title: GPC joins the $$$ Shopping List
summary: 2,550 December $125 calls bought at $2.92 on 11/12, then paid up to about $3.50; 500 March $140 calls bought in a calendar spread against February $140 calls; 3,000 November $130 long calls in open interest are underwater; spot $122.84. Shares held the 200-day and the weekly volatility stop off the May lows; a flag is forming with about $141 to clear. Analyst Day Dec 8-9 is the catalyst.
